title: Quantum Frequency Records Opens Its Doors
subtitle: Launch Announcement
excerpt: A new independent label launches with a different idea of what the artist-label relationship can be.
body: Quantum Frequency Records is officially open. Built around a simple belief—that great music needs room to become great—the independent label launches with a sixteen-artist roster spanning country, rock, punk, electronic, psychedelic, industrial, nu-metal, pop and everything between. QFR was created to build a different kind of relationship between artists and labels: transparent partnerships, patient development, modern technology and a long-term path toward artist ownership. There is no house sound. There is no requirement to fit a predetermined commercial lane. The music comes first, the partnership comes second, and success is something the artist and label are meant to build together.
